name: Film and Media Studies
notes: Six courses. Students are admitted to the minor on the recommendation of the FMS Director, and individualized concentrations for studying motion pictures may also be proposed.
DEPARTMENT CODE: the minor page writes 'FMS 131' and 'FMS 132'; the registrar's catalog prefix is FMST.

CATEGORY LISTS ARE TERM-DEPENDENT - NEEDS VERIFICATION: the department's course-categories page lists only the courses offered in the captured term, and several of its numbers are absent from the 2025-26 catalog. Confirm the current lists with the program.
The FMS MAJOR is a separate pair of entries (major-fmst-theory-ba and major-fmst-production-ba).
